summary.root_cause_text: Order worker thread got stuck in a wait state and stopped consuming the queue. The heartbeat still looked alive. The deeper cause is unknown.
recommended: Find out why the worker entered the wait state and never resumed.
Alert on processed not advancing while queue_depth grows, since the heartbeat does not catch this.
